# Generated gRPC TypeScript

**Do not edit.** Regenerate with:

```bash
bun run proto:gen
```

Source of truth: `proto/**/*.proto`. Generator: `@protobuf-ts/plugin` (`ts_nocheck`, `long_type_string`, `eslint_disable`).

Fields are **camelCase** (protobuf-ts convention). The hand-written types in `src/grpc/types/*.ts` use snake_case and remain in place as the current consumer surface. Migrate consumers to import from `@/grpc/gen/*` when swapping shapes.
